The Claude Code sessions running on this machine, each with the chats tracking it and
the agents tied to it, so Chats can suggest the ones nothing tracks yet.

AcknowledgementRequest.title: AcknowledgementRequest
AcknowledgementRequest.description: A message's request to be acknowledged, as the caller sees it.

AcknowledgementTarget.title: AcknowledgementTarget
AcknowledgementTarget.description: One slot of an acknowledgement request: a named participant, a role, or any agent or anyone.

Actor.title: Actor
Actor.description: The person or an agent identity, by the label it has now.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: An agent identity with its credentials, its runs and what it is tied to, and why.

AgentLinkSet.title: AgentLinkSet
AgentLinkSet.description: The person names the agent. An agent ties only itself, so it may leave agentId out.

AgentListed.title: AgentListed
AgentListed.description: An agent identity as the Agents page lists it, gathered from what it wrote.

AgentMessage.title: AgentMessage
AgentMessage.description: A message one agent of the chat sent another, or one received from outside it.

AgentProfile.title: AgentProfile
AgentProfile.description: An agent identity as a participant's profile shows it, to any caller.

AgentRole.title: AgentRole
AgentRole.description: A responsibility role an agent owns, with the roadmap it sits within.

AgentRun.title: AgentRun
AgentRun.description: A run: one stretch of an agent's work under one credential, as it reported it.

AgentRunWithChats.title: AgentRunWithChats
AgentRunWithChats.description: A run with the tracked chats that carry the chat ID it reported.

AgentSummary.title: AgentSummary
AgentSummary.description: An agent identity, by its label. One without a live credential reads as archived.

AgentTie.title: AgentTie
AgentTie.description: An agent's tie to a record, with the agent and the record as they stand now.

AgentWork.title: AgentWork
AgentWork.description: Open participation an agent reports: the work and the repositories it is at now.

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: A message someone else posted in a repository's own discussion, the opening one aside.

AppliedChange.title: AppliedChange
AppliedChange.description: One change of an applied proposal that was made to the record, by its number in the proposal.

Attachment.title: Attachment
Attachment.description: An attached file's details; its bytes are read on their own.

Author.title: Author
Author.description:
Who wrote a reminder, a ticket or a ticket's comment, as written then, with the avatar their
agent identity has now.

BackupFile.title: BackupFile
BackupFile.description: A backup or raw recovery file, by its file's metadata; Settings reads no hashes.

BoundRecipient.title: BoundRecipient
BoundRecipient.description: A run a message sent now would reach: its identity registered with the chat or was confirmed in it.

Change.title: Change
Change.description: One entry of a record's history as the record's own read lists it: who changed it, how and when.

ChatAgent.title: ChatAgent
ChatAgent.description: An agent identity tied to a chat ID, by its closest tie.

ChatListed.title: ChatListed
ChatListed.description: A tracked chat as the Chats page lists it.

ChatMessageSent.title: ChatMessageSent
ChatMessageSent.description: A message the person wrote into a chat, with each recipient's delivery as it stands now.

ChatMessages.title: ChatMessages
ChatMessages.description: A tracked chat's messages, newest first, with who a message sent now would reach.

ChatOwner.title: ChatOwner
ChatOwner.description: The work item or roadmap a tracked chat belongs to; empty if that record is missing.

ChatRecipient.title: ChatRecipient
ChatRecipient.description: An open run that reports a chat's ID, and its agent identity.

ChatStep.title: ChatStep
ChatStep.description: A step a tracked chat works on, with its status as its roadmap shows it.

ChatTrack.title: ChatTrack
ChatTrack.description:
Track the chat the calling agent registered with on a work item or roadmap, and on steps
of that roadmap. Worklog takes the chat's ID from the identity, never from the request.

ClaudeSession.title: ClaudeSession
ClaudeSession.description: A Claude Code session running on this machine, with the chats and agents tied to it.

Context.title: Context
Context.description: A tag: a record of one kind by its id, or a ticket by its key or number.

ContextTag.title: ContextTag
ContextTag.description:
A record a discussion is tagged with, or that a role in it brings in, as record_kinds.summary
gives it, with who added the tag and when. A missing record has a null title.

CoordinationUpdate.title: CoordinationUpdate
CoordinationUpdate.description: A status update a run posted on its participation.

CredentialSponsor.title: CredentialSponsor
CredentialSponsor.description: The agent that registered a credential, by its label then.

DiscussedRepository.title: DiscussedRepository
DiscussedRepository.description: A repository with its own discussion's id (v22), as the list, its read and a resolved address show it.

DiscussionChange.title: DiscussionChange
DiscussionChange.description: One change in the discussions feed, after the cursor it was read from.

DiscussionResume.title: DiscussionResume
DiscussionResume.description: What an agent needs to pick up a work context's discussions: roles, threads, pending requests and a feed cursor.

DiscussionRole.title: DiscussionRole
DiscussionRole.description: A responsibility role on a work item, roadmap or step, with its owner and any pending offer.

DiscussionSummary.title: DiscussionSummary
DiscussionSummary.description: A discussion as lists show it: its tags and how many acknowledgement requests are pending.

DiscussionThread.title: DiscussionThread
DiscussionThread.description: A discussion with a page of its messages, oldest first.

Done.title: Done
Done.description: A command that changed what it was asked to, or found nothing to change, and names nothing back.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: One entry of a record's history in full: the record before and after the change, as written then.

FamilyRoadmap.title: FamilyRoadmap
FamilyRoadmap.description: A roadmap above or below another, as that one lists it.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: Whether this Worklog answers, and which instance and data it serves.

HomeRepository.title: HomeRepository
HomeRepository.description: The repository whose own discussion this is.

ListedGithubReference.title: ListedGithubReference
ListedGithubReference.description: A GitHub reference as its owner lists it, with the title of the chat that made it.

MessageActivity.title: MessageActivity
MessageActivity.description: A discussion message the agent posted.

OverlapDiscussion.title: OverlapDiscussion
OverlapDiscussion.description: Another open thread tagged with a named record, where someone besides the caller wrote.

OverlapParticipation.title: OverlapParticipation
OverlapParticipation.description: Another agent's open participation in the repositories, on the work items, or on work on the steps.

OverlapTag.title: OverlapTag
OverlapTag.description: One of the named records a thread is tagged with.

Overlaps.title: Overlaps
Overlaps.description: Who else is on the named records and what they said there, leaving out the caller's own.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description:
The person or an agent identity as they stand now: who a ticket is assigned to, or who is
on the records an overlap check names.

Participants.title: Participants
Participants.description: Everyone who can take part in a discussion: the person first, then each agent identity.

Participation.title: Participation
Participation.description: What a run reports working on: a work item or none, and the repositories it works in.

ParticipationRepository.title: ParticipationRepository
ParticipationRepository.description: A repository a participation reports working in, and where.

Person.title: Person
Person.description: A person with what they are tied to and their history.

PersonListed.title: PersonListed
PersonListed.description: A person as the people list shows them, with how many active records each kind ties them to.

PersonRecord.title: PersonRecord
PersonRecord.description: A person's own fields, as their commands return them.

PersonTie.title: PersonTie
PersonTie.description: A person's tie to a work item, roadmap or repository, as setting it returns it.

PersonUntied.title: PersonUntied
PersonUntied.description: The tie a person no longer has.

PlanRoadmap.title: PlanRoadmap
PlanRoadmap.description: A roadmap's own fields as plans.list gives them, which the context lists.

PlanStep.title: PlanStep
PlanStep.description:
A step's own fields, as a roadmap's steps and its saved revisions give them. A parent's
status is derived from its leaves.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: A proposal as its own read returns it, with its evidence files.

ProposalEntry.title: ProposalEntry
ProposalEntry.description: A proposal as a history lists it, the latest first, with the number of its changes.

ProposalListed.title: ProposalListed
ProposalListed.description: A proposal as GET /proposals and the context list it: whole, without its evidence files.

ProposalOperation.title: ProposalOperation
ProposalOperation.description: One change a proposal makes, as its create or last update checked it.

Rank.title: Rank
Rank.description: revision is the item's own; a rank past the last moves the item last.

RankResult.title: RankResult
RankResult.description: A work item's stack rank after a move, 1 first, among how many ranked items.

RecordHistory.title: RecordHistory
RecordHistory.description: A record's latest history entries the reader may see.

RecordPerson.title: RecordPerson
RecordPerson.description: A person tied to a work item, roadmap or repository, as that record lists them.

RecordSummary.title: RecordSummary
RecordSummary.description: A roadmap, person, resource or discussion.

RegistryWorkItem.title: RegistryWorkItem
RegistryWorkItem.description: A work item as the registry names it, with the roadmap its step, or it, sits on.

Release.title: Release
Release.description: A release with what it holds, its changes, every check and who changed them when.

ReleaseChange.title: ReleaseChange
ReleaseChange.description: A PR or commit: one the release holds itself (direct), or one on a work item or roadmap it holds.

ReleaseCounts.title: ReleaseCounts
ReleaseCounts.description:
A listed release's active work items and the done ones, its open checks of each kind, and
how many open checks are past due.

ReleaseHistoryEntry.title: ReleaseHistoryEntry
ReleaseHistoryEntry.description:
A change to a release or one of its checks, which entityId names, without its records:
/history has those.

ReleaseItem.title: ReleaseItem
ReleaseItem.description: A work item a release holds.

ReleaseRoadmap.title: ReleaseRoadmap
ReleaseRoadmap.description: A roadmap a release holds, with its finished leaf steps out of all, as its progress bar counts them.

ReleaseStep.title: ReleaseStep
ReleaseStep.description: A step a release holds, with its status as its roadmap shows it: a parent's follows its leaves.

Reminder.title: Reminder
Reminder.description: A reminder with its notes and history, as its own read returns it.

ReminderListed.title: ReminderListed
ReminderListed.description: A reminder as lists show it, without its notes or history.

Repository.title: Repository
Repository.description: A repository of the catalog, as other records embed it.

RepositoryDetail.title: RepositoryDetail
RepositoryDetail.description: A repository as its own read returns it: with its discussion and the people tied to it.

RepositoryEnsure.title: RepositoryEnsure
RepositoryEnsure.description: Register a remote, or find the record that already holds it.

RepositoryMerge.title: RepositoryMerge
RepositoryMerge.description: Merge the addressed repository into `intoId`; both revisions must be current.

RepositoryResolution.title: RepositoryResolution
RepositoryResolution.description: What registering an address would do: link to the record holding its remote, or add one.

RepositorySummary.title: RepositorySummary
RepositorySummary.description: A repository, by its name. A merged one reads as archived.

ResourceListed.title: ResourceListed
ResourceListed.description: A resource as lists show it, without the page's text.

Roadmap.title: Roadmap
Roadmap.description: A roadmap with everything its page shows.

RoadmapImport.title: RoadmapImport
RoadmapImport.description: A plan import committed to the roadmap; its original is read on its own.

RoadmapRecord.title: RoadmapRecord
RoadmapRecord.description: A roadmap's own fields, as other records embed it.

RoadmapSnapshot.title: RoadmapSnapshot
RoadmapSnapshot.description: A saved revision of a roadmap: its title, overview and steps as they stood then.

RoadmapStep.title: RoadmapStep
RoadmapStep.description: A step as its roadmap lists it, with its notes and files.

RoadmapTie.title: RoadmapTie
RoadmapTie.description: What ties a worker to a roadmap's step now, or to the roadmap itself with a null stepId.

RoadmapWorkItem.title: RoadmapWorkItem
RoadmapWorkItem.description: A work item on the roadmap or one of its steps, with the people tied to it.

RoadmapWorker.title: RoadmapWorker
RoadmapWorker.description: An agent at work on the roadmap, or a tracked chat that stands for itself.

RoleOfferOpen.title: RoleOfferOpen
RoleOfferOpen.description: A role's pending offer to another agent identity.

SavedRoadmap.title: SavedRoadmap
SavedRoadmap.description:
A roadmap as its commands return it: its steps, retired ones included, and versions. The
supporting lists are always empty here; its read fills them.

SavedStep.title: SavedStep
SavedStep.description: A step as its update returns it, with its roadmap.

SessionChat.title: SessionChat
SessionChat.description: A tracked chat that follows a running session.

StatusSummary.title: StatusSummary
StatusSummary.description: A work item or proposal. A proposal is never archived; its status says where it got to.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: A step as its own read returns it: with its roadmap, and retired or not.

StepContextTag.title: StepContextTag
StepContextTag.description: A step's or a question's tag, with the roadmap it opens on.

StepSummary.title: StepSummary
StepSummary.description: A step or question, with its roadmap. A retired step reads as archived.

StepUpdate.title: StepUpdate
StepUpdate.description: revision is the step's own. A field given replaces the step's text; one left out keeps it.

TabCounts.title: TabCounts
TabCounts.description: What a work item's tabs on Today hold, so they say so before the item is read.

TaskMove.title: TaskMove
TaskMove.description:
revision is the task's own; position is its new place among the work item's active tasks,
1 first, and a place past the last moves it last.

TaskPlace.title: TaskPlace
TaskPlace.description: Where a moved task now stands in its work item's list, 1 first.

Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description: A ticket whole, with its latest comments and who changed it when.

TicketListed.title: TicketListed
TicketListed.description: A ticket as lists show it: its description and resolution cut to 1,000 characters each.

TicketWorkItem.title: TicketWorkItem
TicketWorkItem.description: The work item a ticket names.

TieAgent.title: TieAgent
TieAgent.description: An agent as its ties show it.

TiedChat.title: TiedChat
TiedChat.description: A tracked chat whose chat ID the agent reported.

ToolsMessage.title: ToolsMessage
ToolsMessage.description: A run of tool calls between messages, as one line of activity.

Transcript.title: Transcript
Transcript.description: A tracked chat's latest transcript messages, oldest first, with its agents.

TranscriptSummary.title: TranscriptSummary
TranscriptSummary.description: A chat's agents and their latest activity, read from the tool's transcript files on this machine.

TranscriptThread.title: TranscriptThread
TranscriptThread.description: One agent's transcript in a chat: the chat itself or a subagent it started.

UnreadTranscript.title: UnreadTranscript
UnreadTranscript.description: A chat's summary when its transcript could not be read: it never fails the list.

UpdateActivity.title: UpdateActivity
UpdateActivity.description: A status update one of the agent's runs posted.

WorkContext.title: WorkContext
WorkContext.description:
What an agent reads before it starts: the day, the work, the plans, the people, the proposals,
who is at work where, and the tickets, resources and releases.

WorkItem.title: WorkItem
WorkItem.description: A work item with everything its page shows.

WorkItemRecord.title: WorkItemRecord
WorkItemRecord.description: A work item's own fields, as other records embed it.
